You first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

The only account of the guard in the channel is your 10:42 message, which says the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 message says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Your 11:08 message says both lanes were working as of 11:07. Nothing in the channel records what the guard did between 11:03 and 11:07, or whether the guard was on the clipboard the whole time. For that, check with the guard or the gate log.
